plan.title: AppSec: 2 HIGH — post-#3288 UAT Shell residuals (alt bins plant authz grants + kill-switch)

narratives.Description: After #3288, UAT Shell still fail-opens on versioned and alternate binaries that plant `.deft/authz` grants or the Directive kill-switch. Those bins classify as empty / unclassifiable and allow write-shaped Shell, which bypasses Wave 1 human approval.
narratives.UserStory: As a Directive operator running active UAT, I want alternate and versioned write bins to classify as settings deny when they target authz grants or the kill-switch, so that agents cannot plant forged operator-cli grants or disable Directive.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: 1. Add residual bins (`gpg2`, `rage`, `xh`, `httpie`, `wcurl`, `curlie`, `uudecode`, `iconv`, `gtar`, `star`, and close peers) to downloader/decoder and archive-alt write detection in `packages/core/src/authz/classify.ts`. 2. Treat those destinations as settings when they write into `.deft/authz/**` or plant `.deft-directive-disable` / `.no-deft-directive`. 3. Prefer fail-closed on unclassifiable write-shaped Shell under active UAT in classify/evaluate. 4. Extend `classify.test.ts` (and evaluate tests if the fail-closed path lives there) with residual-bin vs already-denied peer cases and ordinary non-authz download negatives. 5. Add a CHANGELOG Unreleased entry.
narratives.Overview:
## Summary

AppSec review residual after **#3288**: two **HIGH** UAT Shell classification gaps remain on versioned / alternate binaries. Under active UAT, these paths still classify as empty / unclassifiable and **allow** write-shaped Shell that can plant forged `.deft/authz` grants or the kill-switch, bypassing Wave 1 human-approval and Directive gates.

**Repo / tip:** `deftai/directive` @ `e3c9490d7225aeaf8683036e2bdd512edb29df4e`  
**Primary code:** `packages/core/src/authz/classify.ts`  
**Attacker model:** Agent under **active UAT** with PreToolUse Shell hooks

## Findings

### 1. HIGH — UAT residual: `gpg2` / `rage` / `xh` / `httpie` / `wcurl` / … still plant `.deft/authz` grants

| Field | Detail |
|-------|--------|
| **Location** | `packages/core/src/authz/classify.ts` |
| **Attacker** | Agent under active UAT with PreToolUse Shell hooks |
| **Input** | `gpg2 -o .deft/authz/grants/evil.json …`, `rage -d -o …`, `xh` / `httpie` / `wcurl` / `curlie -o …`, `uudecode -o`, `iconv -o`, `gtar` / `star -C .deft/authz/…` |
| **Path** | #3288 denies `gpg` / `age` / `http` / `tar`; **versioned / alt bins** classify `[]` → `shell-op-unclassifiable` **allow** → forged **operator-cli** grant → Write / push / PR / merge unlock |
| **Impact** | Complete Wave 1 UAT human-approval bypass |
| **Fix** | Add `gpg2` / `rage` / `xh` / `httpie` / `wcurl` / `curlie` / `uudecode` / `iconv` / `gtar` / `star` (+ peers) to downloader/decoder write detection; prefer **fail-closed** on unclassifiable write-shaped Shell under UAT |

### 2. HIGH — UAT residual: same alt bins still plant `.deft-directive-disable`

| Field | Detail |
|-------|--------|
| **Location** | `packages/core/src/authz/classify.ts` |
| **Attacker** | Agent under active UAT |
| **Input** | Same alternate binaries targeting `.deft-directive-disable` |
| **Path** | classify `[]` → Shell **allow** → plant kill-switch → subsequent tools `allow` / `directive-disabled` (#3039) |
| **Impact** | Immediate full Directive gate bypass for the session |
| **Fix** | Classify those destinations as **settings** under UAT; mirror authz fail-closed posture |

## Evidence

Vitest on HEAD:

- Residual bins → `classifyShellAuthzOps([])` + Bash `allow` / `shell-op-unclassifiable`
- Contrast: `gpg` / `age` / `http` / `curl` / `tar` still **settings-denied**
- Forged operator-cli grant unlocks Write

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Under active UAT, listed residual binaries that write into `.deft/authz/**` classify as **settings deny** (not unclassifiable allow)
- [ ] Same bins targeting `.deft-directive-disable` / `.no-deft-directive` classify as **settings deny**
- [ ] Prefer fail-closed on unclassifiable **write-shaped** Shell under UAT (not silent allow)
- [ ] Regression tests cover residual bins vs already-denied peers (`gpg`/`age`/`http`/`curl`/`tar`)
- [ ] No false deny of ordinary non-authz / non-kill-switch downloads outside UAT write paths

## Related

- Residual of #3288 UAT Shell hardening
- Kill-switch contract: #3039
- Prior authz UAT Shell residual class: #3206, #3213, #3245, #3186

## Labels / routing

Security / agent-safety / tooling — framework-source fix in `packages/core/src/authz/`.
